name: Shikima Nene
source:
Age at Death: 10

Nene is one of the ghost girls who possessed [url=/c49917]Chiyako[/url], and the fourth victim of the Spirited Away incident. She has considerable interest in the sexual passion between men and women because of her mother, and herself being force-ripe. Without any romantic experiences throughout her lifetime, she demands some with [url=/c64207]Shuuichi[/url] so daringly as to embarrass Chiyako.

[From [url=https://fruitbatfactory.com/7days/#char]official English page[/url]]
